senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.5.8 yaśadam यशदम्
Zinc
Zn (Zinc). Duly processed yashada is employed as a standalone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-9.5.56 yaṣṭikarṇaḥ यष्टिकर्णः
Lobuloplasty type 14
A type of lobuloplasty indicated when both flaps of the split lobule have keloid tissue, are vascular and very small.
